## Checklist

- [ ] One topic per PR.
- [ ] Public API unchanged (`FaceVaultClient`, `createSession`, `getSession`, `verifySignature`, `parseEvent`, error classes), or the break is called out above and justified.
- [ ] `dist/` is not committed (it's gitignored and built by CI).
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (if user-facing).
